name: NG exhaustion Phase-1 Agent 7 open higher-order mechanism discovery
purpose: Give an independent Phase-1 lane authority to discover higher-order chains and mathematical/nonlinear mechanisms that the existing ridge/KNN/extra-trees depth lane may miss. Agent 7 is a peer discovery lane, not a post-hoc explainer.

valid_candidate_examples: nonlinear recurrence across multiple prior aftermath vectors
polynomial or interaction equation across lagged behavior
survival/hazard relation over sequential predictive memory
discovery_authority.rule: Any mathematical or statistical relation may propose a Phase-1 chain/depth if it is defined using the frozen canonical event sequence and is chosen without access to the corresponding out-of-time test outcomes. It becomes evidence only if it survives temporal out-of-time validation and independent falsification.

search_families.equation_fitter: training-era regularized linear regression over the nonlinear feature library, with regularization chosen inside training eras only
search_families.nonparametric_crosscheck: extra trees over the same lag history as an independent nonlinear benchmark
search_families.equation_reporting: Record the selected transformed terms and coefficients for surviving explicit equations; do not report a black-box score alone when the equation lane is the source of a candidate.

relationship_to_other_agents.agent3_structural_depth: complementary benchmark, not a gate on Agent 7 discovery
relationship_to_other_agents.agent4_causal_executable: Any Agent 7 structural mechanism must be separately marked executable or retrospective using the frozen causal-availability semantics.
relationship_to_other_agents.agent5_lineage: Any surviving Agent 7 higher-order mechanism is passed to lineage analysis to distinguish inherited-origin from rolling/re-origin propagation and to measure instance-specific lifespan.
relationship_to_other_agents.agent6_falsifier: Agent 7 discoveries receive the same leakage/null/nonstationarity/omitted-state attacks as Agent 3 discoveries.
